title: Can chocolate ever be healthy
titleChinese: 巧克力能成为健康食品吗？
paragraphs: When you think of foods that are good for you, chocolate may not be high up on your list. But, there has been a lot of research into dark chocolate, which shows that it does, in fact, have health benefits.

Chocolate is made by roasting cacao seeds, which come from the cacao tree. After being processed into cocoa solids, cocoa butter and combined with sugar and sometimes dairy, chocolate is the result. To know how dark the chocolate is, and to determine the potential health benefits, we need to look at the level of cocoa solids it contains.

If dark chocolate has a high cocoa content, labelled as a percentage, it may be dense in minerals such as magnesium and iron. According to a 2011 study comparing cacao seeds to ‘super fruits’ such as cranberries and pomegranates, dark chocolate may have high levels of antioxidants. Other research includes a 2018 study which found that dark chocolate could significantly reduce inflammation in people with type 2 diabetes.

But companies trying to market dark chocolate as a healthy snack may have a difficult time – the higher the cocoa content, the more bitter the taste. Plus, commercial dark chocolate tends to be high in calories, saturated fat and can contain significant amounts of sugar. On top of that, during the actual manufacturing process of cleaning, fermenting and roasting the cacao beans, the natural benefits may be lost.
All in all, it seems that consuming a moderate amount of dark chocolate can’t do you harm – just look for a high cocoa solid percentage!

vocabulary.entry: dark chocolate /ˌdɑːk ˈtʃɒklət/ n. 黑巧克力
vocabulary.example: She eats a small piece of dark chocolate every day for its health benefits.
vocabulary.translation: 她每天吃一小块黑巧克力，因为它对健康有益。

vocabulary.entry: roast /rəʊst/ v. 焙炒；烘烤（食物，尤指豆类、肉类）
vocabulary.example: We roast coffee beans fresh every morning in the shop.
vocabulary.translation: 我们店里每天早上新鲜焙炒咖啡豆。

vocabulary.entry: seed /siːd/ n. 种子
vocabulary.example: The farmer planted the seed in the soil at the start of spring.
vocabulary.translation: 农民在初春时把种子播进了土壤里。

vocabulary.entry: process /prəˈses/ v. 加工；处理（原材料、食品等）
vocabulary.example: The factory processes fresh fruit into juice and jam for supermarkets.
vocabulary.translation: 这家工厂将新鲜水果加工成果汁和果酱供应超市。

vocabulary.entry: cocoa solid /ˈkəʊkəʊ ˈsɒlɪd/ n. 可可固形物
vocabulary.example: The level of cocoa solid determines the richness of dark chocolate.
vocabulary.translation: 可可固形物的含量决定了黑巧克力的浓郁度。

vocabulary.entry: cocoa butter /ˈkəʊkəʊ ˈbʌtə(r)/ n. 可可脂
vocabulary.example: Cocoa butter gives chocolate its smooth and creamy texture.
vocabulary.translation: 可可脂让巧克力拥有顺滑绵密的口感。

vocabulary.entry: dairy /ˈdeəri/ n. 乳制品；奶制食品
vocabulary.example: This chocolate contains no dairy, so it’s suitable for vegans.
vocabulary.translation: 这款巧克力不含乳制品，适合素食主义者食用。

vocabulary.entry: potential /pəˈtenʃl/ adj. 潜在的；可能的
vocabulary.example: The new drug has great potential to treat the rare disease.
vocabulary.translation: 这种新药有治疗这种罕见疾病的巨大潜力。

vocabulary.entry: cocoa content /ˈkəʊkəʊ ˈkɒntent/ n. 可可含量
vocabulary.example: Look for chocolate with a high cocoa content if you want more health benefits.
vocabulary.translation: 如果你想获得更多健康益处，就选可可含量高的巧克力。

vocabulary.entry: label /ˈleɪbl/ v. 标注；贴标签；标明
vocabulary.example: All food products must be labelled with their nutritional information.
vocabulary.translation: 所有食品都必须标注其营养成分信息。

vocabulary.entry: percentage /pəˈsentɪdʒ/ n. 百分比；百分率
vocabulary.example: The bottle is labelled with the percentage of alcohol it contains.
vocabulary.translation: 瓶子上标明了其酒精含量的百分比。

vocabulary.entry: dense /dens/ adj. 富含的；稠密的；浓密的
vocabulary.example: This type of bread is dense in fibre and very filling.
vocabulary.translation: 这种面包富含膳食纤维，饱腹感很强。

vocabulary.entry: mineral /ˈmɪnərəl/ n. 矿物质；矿物
vocabulary.example: Green leafy vegetables are a good source of essential minerals like calcium.
vocabulary.translation: 绿叶蔬菜是钙等必需矿物质的良好来源。

vocabulary.entry: magnesium /mæɡˈniːziəm/ n. 镁（一种人体必需的矿物质）
vocabulary.example: Magnesium helps to keep our muscles and nerves working properly.
vocabulary.translation: 镁有助于维持我们的肌肉和神经正常运作。

vocabulary.entry: super fruit /ˈsuːpə fruːt/ n. 超级水果（指营养价值极高的水果）
vocabulary.example: Blueberries and acai berries are often called super fruits for their high antioxidant levels.
vocabulary.translation: 蓝莓和巴西莓因其抗氧化剂含量高，常被称作超级水果。

vocabulary.entry: cranberry /ˈkrænberi/ n. 蔓越莓；蔓越橘
vocabulary.example: Cranberries are often used to make sauce to eat with turkey.
vocabulary.translation: 蔓越莓常被用来制作酱，搭配火鸡食用。

vocabulary.entry: pomegranate /ˈpɒmɪɡrænɪt/ n. 石榴
vocabulary.example: We squeezed fresh pomegranate juice for the summer drinks.
vocabulary.translation: 我们鲜榨了石榴汁来做夏日饮品。

vocabulary.entry: antioxidant /ˌæntiˈɒksɪdənt/ n. 抗氧化剂
vocabulary.example: Antioxidants in fruit and vegetables help to protect the body from damage.
vocabulary.translation: 果蔬中的抗氧化剂有助于保护身体免受损伤。

vocabulary.entry: significantly /sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/ adv. 显著地；明显地；大大地
vocabulary.example: Eating more vegetables has significantly improved her overall health.
vocabulary.translation: 多吃蔬菜显著改善了她的整体健康状况。

vocabulary.entry: inflammation /ˌɪnfləˈmeɪʃn/ n. 炎症；发炎
vocabulary.example: The medicine is used to reduce inflammation in the joints.
vocabulary.translation: 这种药物用于缓解关节的炎症。

vocabulary.entry: type 2 diabetes /taɪp tuː ˌdaɪəˈbiːtiːz/ n. 2型糖尿病
vocabulary.example: A healthy diet and regular exercise can help manage type 2 diabetes.
vocabulary.translation: 健康的饮食和规律的运动有助于控制2型糖尿病。

vocabulary.entry: market /ˈmɑːkɪt/ v. 推销；营销；把……推向市场
vocabulary.example: The company is marketing the new snack as a healthy alternative to crisps.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司正将这款新零食作为薯片的健康替代品进行推销。

vocabulary.entry: bitter /ˈbɪtə(r)/ adj. 味苦的；苦涩的
vocabulary.example: This herbal tea is a little bitter, but it’s very good for you.
vocabulary.translation: 这款花草茶有点苦，但对身体非常有益。

vocabulary.entry: ferment /fəˈment/ v. 发酵；使发酵
vocabulary.example: We leave the grapes to ferment for several weeks to make wine.
vocabulary.translation: 我们让葡萄发酵几周来酿造葡萄酒。

vocabulary.entry: moderate /ˈmɒdərət/ adj. 适度的；适量的；中等的
vocabulary.example: Eating a moderate amount of sugar is important for a balanced diet.
vocabulary.translation: 摄入适量的糖分对于均衡饮食来说十分重要。

sentences.english: When you think of foods that are good for you, chocolate may not be high up on your list.
sentences.chinese: 当你列举有益健康的食物时，巧克力可能不会排在前列。

sentences.english: But, there has been a lot of research into dark chocolate, which shows that it does, in fact, have health benefits.
sentences.chinese: 但针对黑巧克力的大量研究表明，事实上，它其实对健康十分有益。

sentences.english: Chocolate is made by roasting cacao seeds, which come from the cacao tree.
sentences.chinese: 巧克力是由可可树结出的可可豆烘焙制成的。

sentences.english: After being processed into cocoa solids, cocoa butter and combined with sugar and sometimes dairy, chocolate is the result.
sentences.chinese: 可可豆经加工制成可可固形物和可可脂，再加入糖，有时还会添加乳制品，最终就成了巧克力。

sentences.english: To know how dark the chocolate is, and to determine the potential health benefits, we need to look at the level of cocoa solids it contains.
sentences.chinese: 想要判断巧克力的可可含量高低，以及它可能具备的健康益处，我们需要看它所含的可可固形物比例。

sentences.english: If dark chocolate has a high cocoa content, labelled as a percentage, it may be dense in minerals such as magnesium and iron.
sentences.chinese: 如果黑巧克力的可可含量（包装上以百分比标注）较高，那么它就可能富含镁、铁等矿物质。

sentences.english: According to a 2011 study comparing cacao seeds to ‘super fruits’ such as cranberries and pomegranates, dark chocolate may have high levels of antioxidants.
sentences.chinese: 2011年的一项研究将可可豆与蔓越莓、石榴等“超级水果”进行对比，结果发现黑巧克力的抗氧化剂含量可能很高。

sentences.english: Other research includes a 2018 study which found that dark chocolate could significantly reduce inflammation in people with type 2 diabetes.
sentences.chinese: 另有一项2018年的研究表明，黑巧克力能显著减轻2型糖尿病患者的炎症反应。

sentences.english: But companies trying to market dark chocolate as a healthy snack may have a difficult time – the higher the cocoa content, the more bitter the taste.
sentences.chinese: 但企业若想将黑巧克力当作健康零食来推广，可能会面临不小的挑战——可可含量越高，巧克力的味道就越苦。

sentences.english: Plus, commercial dark chocolate tends to be high in calories, saturated fat and can contain significant amounts of sugar.
sentences.chinese: 此外，市售黑巧克力的热量和饱和脂肪含量往往不低，还可能含有大量糖分。

sentences.english: On top of that, during the actual manufacturing process of cleaning, fermenting and roasting the cacao beans, the natural benefits may be lost.
sentences.chinese: 不仅如此，在可可豆清洗、发酵、烘焙的实际生产过程中，其天然有益成分也可能会有所流失。

sentences.english: All in all, it seems that consuming a moderate amount of dark chocolate can’t do you harm – just look for a high cocoa solid percentage!
sentences.chinese: 总而言之，适量食用黑巧克力似乎不会对身体造成伤害——选购时只要认准可可固形物比例高的产品就好！
